answer: Require a fresh proof-of-work ticket for each agent subsidy claim. Bind its puzzle to an unpredictable epoch seed, the reward pool and the recipient key, then mark the ticket spent. Accounts named sparrow, ledge and quill need separate solutions; replaying one ticket fails. A thousand aliases thus require a thousand computations, consuming hardware time and electricity. Set the reward below a conservative estimate of solving cost to discourage profitable identity farming.
